directional_numeric_value_flow.storage: action computes dam = t.getDamage(self, t), then trapping_CreateTrap stores dam as trap self.dam
directional_numeric_value_flow.projection: triggered iterates the radius-2 ball and passes self.dam as a scalar to DamageType.FIREBURN.projector for each grid except the summoner's grid
directional_numeric_value_flow.tooltip_info: damDesc(FIRE, t.getDamage(self, t)) -> info %0.2f; instant -> info %s
directional_numeric_value_flow.displayed_quantity: the complete incoming FIREBURN event total before downstream mitigation, not per-turn damage

scalar_fireburn.applicability: scalar FIREBURN input with no explicit table overrides
scalar_fireburn.immediate_damage: D * 50 / 100 = D/2 projected immediately as FIRE
scalar_fireburn.burning_power: (D/2) / 3 = D/6 per timeout before downstream mitigation
scalar_fireburn.unmerged_nominal_total: D/2 immediate plus three D/6 timeouts equals D
